en_description:
Strike forward 5 times,
dealing 10/10/10/15/30 damage.
☆
Strike forward 5 times.
1 - Thrust, dealing 10 damage.
2 - Slash, dealing 10 damage.
3 - Kick, dealing 10 damage.
4 - Slash, dealing 15 damage.
5 - Cross Slash, dealing 15x2 damage.
cn_description:
对前方进行五段近战攻击，
造成10/10/10/15/30点伤害。
☆
对前方进行五段近战攻击，
1 - 戳刺，造成10点伤害。
2 - 劈砍，造成10点伤害。
3 - 踢，造成10点伤害。
4 - 劈砍，造成15点伤害。
5 - 十字斩，造成15x2点伤害。

en_description: Throw 3 Knife projectiles, each dealing 20 damage. Costs 3 Energy.
cn_description: 发射3把飞刀，每把造成20点伤害，消耗3点能量。

en_description: Dash forward, dealing 15 damage if attacking while Dashing.
cn_description: 向前突进，如果在冲刺时攻击，造成15点伤害。

en_description: Let out a roar to steel yourself, gaining +20% Melee Attack and +30% Attack Speed for 7s. Cooldown: 16s.
cn_description: 通过怒吼激励自己，提升20%的近战攻击力和30%的攻击速度，持续7秒。冷却时间16秒。

en_description: On cast, deal 100 damage to nearby enemies and stun them for 2s.
cn_description: 技能施放时对周围的敌人造成100点伤害，并附加2秒眩晕。

en_description: While active, melee attacks gain +30% Crit Chance.
cn_description: 在持续时间内，提高30%近战攻击的暴击率。

en_description: Cooldown -5s.
cn_description: 冷却时间减少5秒。

en_description: While active, Energy recovery speed +200%.
cn_description: 在持续时间内，提高200%的能量回复速度。

en_description: Each enemy killed extends the duration by 0.8s.
cn_description: 每击杀一个敌人，将持续时间延长0.8秒。

en_description: On use, gain +180% Attack Speed, decaying to +30% over 4s.
cn_description: 使用后，提升的攻击速度变为180%，并在4秒内逐渐衰减至30%。

en_description: Choose a direction to Dash. During Dash, you cannot be targeted by enemies, and you summon Shadow to make 6 Thrust attacks along the path, each dealing 40 damage. Cooldown 9s.
cn_description: 选择一个方向冲刺，冲刺期间无法被敌人选取，并召唤影子对路径上的敌人进行6段戳刺攻击，每段造成40点伤害。冷却时间9秒。

en_description: This skill summons 3 more shadows.
cn_description: 技能召唤的影子数量增加3。

en_description: After casting, gain 5 Shield for 6s.
cn_description: 技能施放后获得5点护盾，护盾持续6秒。

en_description: Thrust hits apply Cripple.
cn_description: 戳刺命中时附加残废。

en_description: Each shadow gains +100% attack range and +25 damage.
cn_description: 每个影子的攻击范围提高100%，伤害增加25点。

en_description: The final reappearance Thrust deals 800% damage and stuns for 2.5s.
cn_description: 技能最后现身时的戳刺伤害提升至800%，并附加2.5秒眩晕。

en_description: No longer moves you; only summons Shadow to perform Thrust. Cooldown reduced by 2s, and it can store 2 charges.
cn_description: 不再进行位移，只召唤影子进行戳刺。冷却时间减少2秒，可以存储2次充能。

en_description: After a brief charge, unleash 3 Slash Waves in a cone ahead. Hold to increase the number of waves, up to 7 after 1.5s. Each Slash Wave deals 40 damage. Cooldown: 10s.
cn_description: 短暂蓄力后，向前方扇形区域斩出3道刀波，刀波数量会随蓄力时间增加，最多蓄力1.5秒并发出7道刀波。每道刀波造成40点伤害。冷却时间10秒。

en_description: Charge speed +100%.
cn_description: 蓄力速度提高100%。

en_description: Slash Wave range increases with charge time by up to +40%. Damage to farther enemies also increases, up to +100%.
cn_description: 刀波距离会随蓄力时间增加40%，并且对更远处的敌人造成的伤害会提高，最多提高100%。

en_description: Instant casts refund 50% of this skill's Cooldown.
cn_description: 瞬间施放时，返还50%的冷却时间。

en_description: Each Slash Wave that hits the same target adds +10 damage.
cn_description: 对同一个目标每命中一个刀波，伤害增加10点。

en_description: When released at full charge, Slash Wave count +6.
cn_description: 刚好蓄满时，刀波数量增加6。

en_description: Gain 16 Shield when charging starts. The Shield decays over 3s.
cn_description: 蓄力开始时获得16点护盾，在3秒内逐渐衰减。

en_description:
Fire a chain hook. On enemy hit, deal 40 damage and stun for 1s.
After hooking an enemy or wall, rapidly pull yourself to the target and perform a Whirlwind Slash in flight, dealing 50 damage to nearby enemies.
Cooldown: 6s.
cn_description:
发射一道铁索，命中敌人时造成40点伤害并附加1秒眩晕。
钩中敌人或墙体后，会迅速拉向目标，并在飞行过程中施放回旋斩，对周围敌人造成50点伤害。
冷却时间6秒。

en_description: Hooking a wall refunds 70% of this skill's Cooldown.
cn_description: 钩中墙壁时返还70%的冷却时间。

en_description: Directly hitting an enemy with the chain adds +60 damage.
cn_description: 铁索直接命中敌人时，伤害增加60点。

en_description: Directly hitting an enemy with the chain applies 4 Wound stacks.
cn_description: 铁索直接命中敌人时，附加4层伤口。

en_description: Whirlwind Slash damage +25 and area of effect +60%.
cn_description: 回旋斩的伤害增加25点，伤害范围扩大60%。

en_description: Cooldown -2s. Stores up to 2 charges.
cn_description: 冷却时间减少2秒，可以存储2次充能。

en_description: No longer Dashes to the target. On enemy hit, pulls the enemy to the cast position and stuns them for 2s.
cn_description: 不再向目标冲刺，而是命中敌人时将敌人拉至施放位置并附加2秒眩晕。

en_description: Spend 3 Energy to throw 3 poison-coated knives forward. Knives pierce up to 1 enemy, dealing 30 damage and applying 2 Poison stacks to each target. Cooldown: 8s.
cn_description: 消耗3点能量，向前方投掷3把淬毒飞刀，飞刀可以穿透最多1个敌人，对每个目标造成30点伤害并附加2层中毒。冷却时间8秒。

en_description: Direct damage +35.
cn_description: 直接伤害增加35点。

en_description: Poison-coated Knives apply +1 Poison stack.
cn_description: 每把淬毒飞刀附加的中毒层数增加1层。

en_description: If Energy is above half when used, poison-coated Knives +3.
cn_description: 如果使用时能量超过一半，淬毒飞刀数量增加3。

en_description: Poison-coated Knives pierce 2 additional targets.
cn_description: 淬毒飞刀的穿透数量增加2。

en_description: When using Knife Throw, cast Venom Blade Rain directly. Energy cost +2.
cn_description: 投掷飞刀时，直接施放毒刃暴雨。能量消耗+2。

en_description: After casting this skill, enter Stealth for 3s.
cn_description: 施放技能后进入潜行，持续3秒。

en_description: Spend 2 Energy to use Knife Throw around you, dealing 50 damage to nearby enemies. After casting, 3 Knife projectiles drop on nearby ground. Cooldown: 4s.
cn_description: 消耗2点能量，向周围投掷飞刀，对周围敌人造成50点伤害。施放技能后，3把飞刀将掉落在附近地面上。冷却时间4秒。

en_description: Nearby Dropped Knives +4.
cn_description: 掉落在附近的飞刀数增加4。

en_description: Stores up to 3 charges.
cn_description: 技能可以存储3次充能。

en_description: If this hits at least 4 enemies, Cooldown -3s.
cn_description: 命中了至少4个敌人时，冷却时间减少3秒。

en_description: Deals more damage to closer enemies, up to +180%.
cn_description: 对越近的敌人造成的伤害会提高，最高提高180%。

en_description: Base damage +30. Each hit on the same enemy adds +9 damage, stacking up to 7 times.
cn_description: 基础伤害增加30点，同一个敌人每次受到刀扇伤害时，再受到9点伤害，最多叠加7层。

en_description: On cast, perform a quick dash before releasing Fan of Knives. Cooldown -1.5s.
cn_description: 施放技能时，先进行一次快速位移，再释放刀扇。冷却时间减少1.5秒。

en_description: Throw a Smoke Bomb at your feet. The smoke lasts 3s. Every 0.6s, summon a shadow clone to attack once inside the smoke. While in the smoke and not attacking, enter Stealth. Cooldown: 15s.
cn_description: 在脚下投掷一个烟雾弹，烟雾持续3秒。每0.6秒召唤影分身在烟雾中攻击一次。在烟雾中未攻击时，进入隐身。冷却时间15秒。

en_description: Enemies in the smoke suffer -65% Movement Speed.
cn_description: 烟雾中的敌人移动速度减少65%。

en_description: Applies 3 Poison stacks per second to enemies in the smoke.
cn_description: 每秒对烟雾中的敌人附加3层中毒。

en_description: Cooldown -4s.
cn_description: 冷却时间减少4秒。

en_description: While in the smoke, Energy recovery speed +300%.
cn_description: 在烟雾中，能量恢复速度提升300%。

en_description: Shadow clones attack 150% faster.
cn_description: 影分身的攻击频率提高150%。

en_description: Duration +2.5s, but no longer summons shadow clones to attack.
cn_description: 持续时间增加2.5秒，不再召唤影分身攻击。

en_description: Rush to the target location, then Thrust 4 times toward the nearest enemy. Each Thrust deals 30 area damage. Cooldown: 8s.
cn_description: 快速冲向目标位置，然后朝最近的敌人方向戳刺4次。每次戳刺造成30点范围伤害。冷却时间8秒。

en_description: Stores up to 3 charges.
cn_description: 技能可以存储3次充能。

en_description: On enemy hit, stun for 2s.
cn_description: 命中敌人时，附加2秒眩晕。

en_description: Thrust distance +75%.
cn_description: 戳刺距离提高75%。

en_description: Thrusts deal +200% Backstab damage.
cn_description: 戳刺造成的背刺伤害提高200%。

en_description: Thrust count +3.
cn_description: 戳刺次数增加3。

en_description: (Passive) When Dashing, 30% chance to summon a shadow to Thrust once at the nearest enemy.
cn_description: （被动）冲刺时，有30%的几率召唤影子向最近的敌人进行一次戳刺。

en_description: Call down lightning, dealing 55 damage to enemies in range and Linking them together for 2.5s. Cooldown: 11s.
cn_description: 召唤一道闪电，对范围内的敌人造成55点伤害，并将这些敌人链接在一起，持续2.5秒。冷却时间11秒。

en_description: Cooldown -3.5s.
cn_description: 冷却时间减少3.5秒。

en_description: Skill area +40%.
cn_description: 技能范围提高40%。

en_description: Lightning damage +40.
cn_description: 闪电伤害增加40点。

en_description: This skill also applies Armor Break for 2.5s.
cn_description: 技能同时附加破甲，持续2.5秒。

en_description: If the lightning hits you, reduce all other skill Cooldowns by 4s.
cn_description: 闪电击中你时，使其他技能的冷却时间减少4秒。

en_description: Link duration +3.5s.
cn_description: 链接的持续时间增加3.5秒。

en_description: Dash forward and slash. Recast within 3.5s to chain up to 3 strikes total, dealing 25/40/55 damage to enemies hit. Cooldown: 12s.
cn_description: 向前冲刺斩击，在3.5秒内可再次施放，总共可施放3段。对攻击到的敌人造成25/40/55点伤害。冷却时间12秒。

en_description: Dash forward and slash. Recast within 3.5s to chain up to 3 strikes total, dealing 25/40/55 damage to enemies hit. Cooldown: 12s.
cn_description: 向前冲刺斩击，在3.5秒内可再次施放，总共可施放3段。对攻击到的敌人造成25/40/55点伤害。冷却时间12秒。

en_description: Dash forward and slash. Recast within 3.5s to chain up to 3 strikes total, dealing 25/40/55 damage to enemies hit. Cooldown: 12s.
cn_description: 向前冲刺斩击，在3.5秒内可再次施放，总共可施放3段。对攻击到的敌人造成25/40/55点伤害。冷却时间12秒。

en_description: This skill gains +25% Crit Chance.
cn_description: 此技能的暴击率提高25%。

en_description: Cooldown -4s.
cn_description: 冷却时间降低4秒。

en_description: When this skill deals damage, gain 5 Shield for 1.5s.
cn_description: 技能造成伤害时，获得5点护盾，持续1.5秒。

en_description: The 3rd stage stuns for 3s.
cn_description: 第三段技能附加持续3秒的眩晕。

en_description: When your Health is below 12%, the 3rd stage restores 8 Health on hit.
cn_description: 生命值小于12%时，第三段技能命中时可以回复8点生命值。

en_description: The 3rd stage Dashes farther and deals +150% damage.
cn_description: 第三段技能的冲刺距离提高，伤害提高150%。

en_description:
Use Knife Throw continuously toward the target direction, firing 12 Knife projectiles per second. Each deals 32 damage.
Costs 4 Energy per second. Stops when Energy runs out or when you cast another skill. Requires at least 4 Energy to cast.
While throwing, Movement Speed is reduced to 25%. Cooldown: 14s.
cn_description:
向目标方向连续投掷飞刀，每秒发射12枚飞刀，每枚造成32点伤害。
每秒消耗4点能量。能量耗尽时，停止施放。施放其他技能时，停止施放。施放需要至少4点能量。
投掷期间，移动速度降低至25%。冷却时间14秒。

en_description: Restore 2 Energy when killing an enemy.
cn_description: 击杀敌人时，回复2点能量。

en_description: Increases knives fired per second to 15.
cn_description: 每秒发射数量提高到15发。

en_description: While casting, Movement Speed increases to 75%.
cn_description: 施放期间，移动速度提高到75%。

en_description: While casting, you can no longer move or Dash. This skill gains +35% Crit Chance.
cn_description: 施放期间，不再能移动或冲刺。此技能的暴击率提高35%。

en_description: When casting stops because Energy runs out, fire 12 Knives in a cone ahead.
cn_description: 因能量耗尽而停止施放时，向前方扇形区域发射12发飞刀。

en_description: Cooldown becomes 4s.
cn_description: 冷却时间降低到4秒。

en_description: Cleave enemies ahead with a heavy strike, dealing 135 base damage. If this kills an enemy, this skill's Cooldown becomes 3s. Cooldown: 14s.
cn_description: 重劈前方敌人，造成135点基础伤害。造成击杀时，冷却时间降低到3秒。冷却时间14秒。

en_description: Each Wound stack on the enemy adds +20 damage.
cn_description: 敌人身上的每层伤口使伤害提高20点。

en_description: This skill instantly kills enemies below 12% Health.
cn_description: 此技能会直接杀死生命值小于12%的敌人。

en_description: When this skill kills an enemy, its base damage permanently increases by 0.5.
cn_description: 此技能击杀敌人时，永久增加0.5点基础伤害。

en_description: Area of effect +35%. Applies Fear for 2s to all enemies hit.
cn_description: 伤害范围扩大35%。并对命中的所有敌人附加2秒恐惧。

en_description: When this skill kills an enemy, gain +75% Attack Speed and +15% Movement Speed for 3s.
cn_description: 此技能击杀敌人时，攻击速度提高75%，移动速度提高15%，持续3秒。

en_description: Cooldown becomes 5s.
cn_description: 冷却时间降低到5秒。

en_description: Leap to the target location, dealing 110 damage to enemies in an X-shaped area and stunning them for 1.5s. Cooldown: 9s.
cn_description: 跳跃到目标位置，对X型范围内的敌人造成110点伤害，并附加1.5秒眩晕。冷却时间9秒。

en_description: Enemies at the center of the cross take damage twice.
cn_description: 对十字中心的敌人造成两次伤害。

en_description: Base damage +30. Area of effect +30%.
cn_description: 基础伤害+30，作用范围扩大30%。

en_description: This skill gains +35% Crit Chance.
cn_description: 技能暴击率提高35%。

en_description: Enemies hit are Linked together for 5s.
cn_description: 命中的敌人被链接在一起，持续5秒。

en_description: When cast, leave a shadow that repeats this skill after 2.5s, dealing 50% damage and stunning for 1s.
cn_description: 施放技能时留下一个影子，在2.5秒后重复施放一次技能，造成50%伤害并附加1秒眩晕

en_description: When a nearby enemy dies, this skill's Cooldown -1s.
cn_description: 周围敌人死亡时，技能冷却时间减少1秒。

en_description: Launch a flying kick toward the target direction, dealing 90 damage to the first target hit and 50% damage to nearby enemies. On hit, leap backward and restore 4 Energy. Cooldown: 6.5s.
cn_description: 朝目标方向飞踢，对命中的首个目标造成90点伤害，对周围的敌人造成50%伤害。命中后迅速向后跳跃，并回复4点能量。冷却时间6.5秒。

en_description: Damage to nearby enemies increases to 100%.
cn_description: 对周围敌人的伤害提高到100%。

en_description: Stores up to 3 charges.
cn_description: 技能可以存储3次充能。

en_description: When cast at close range, hitting an enemy knocks them back farther and applies Armor Break for 5s.
cn_description: 近距离施放并命中敌人时，将敌人额外击退并附加破甲，持续5秒。

en_description: Damage +40.
cn_description: 伤害增加40点。

en_description: Energy restored by this skill +2.
cn_description: 技能回复的能量提高2点。

en_description: On crit, reset this skill's Cooldown.
cn_description: 暴击时，重置此技能的冷却时间。

en_description: Summon 3 flying blades that orbit you, dealing 14 damage when they touch enemies. Lasts 4s. Cooldown: 15s.
cn_description: 召唤3个飞刃环绕自身旋转，触碰敌人时造成14点伤害。持续4秒。冷却时间15秒。

en_description: Flying blade count +1.
cn_description: 飞刃数量增加1。

en_description: When the blades return to you, fully restore Energy.
cn_description: 飞刃回到自身时，回满能量。

en_description: Cooldown -5s.
cn_description: 冷却时间减少5秒。

en_description: While surrounded by flying blades, damage taken -20%.
cn_description: 被飞刃环绕时，承受伤害减少20%。

en_description: Flying blades no longer follow your movement. Duration +3s.
cn_description: 飞刃不再跟随移动。技能持续时间+3秒。

en_description: While active, each enemy killed increases rotation speed by 20%.
cn_description: 持续期间，每击杀一个敌人时，旋转速度提高20%。

en_description: Throw a cloud of black mist at the target location, creating a shadow. The shadow has 28 base Attack, automatically chases nearby enemies, and lasts 6s. Stores up to 2 charges. Cooldown: 8s.
cn_description: 向目标位置投掷一团黑雾，形成一个影子。影子拥有28点基础攻击力，自动追击附近的敌人，持续6秒。技能可以存储2次充能。冷却时间8秒。

en_description: When summoning a shadow, the black mist deals 70 damage and applies Cripple for 2.5s.
cn_description: 召唤影子时，黑雾造成70点伤害，并附加残废，持续2.5秒。

en_description: Shadow Attack Speed +35%.
cn_description: 影子的攻击速度提高35%。

en_description: Shadow uses Knife Throw at enemies. Cooldown 4s.
cn_description: 影子向敌人投掷飞刀。冷却时间4秒。

en_description: Cooldown -1s. Stores up to 3 charges.
cn_description: 冷却时间减少1秒，技能可以存储3次。

en_description: Shadow duration +7s. Summoning costs 2 additional Energy.
cn_description: 影子持续时间增加7秒，召唤时额外消耗2点能量。

en_description: (Passive) Whenever you spend 12 Energy, summon a Shadow Clone beside you to fight.
cn_description: （被动）每消耗12点能量时，召唤一个影分身在身边协助作战。

en_description: Coat your weapon with Poison. For the next 4.25s, all melee attacks apply 2 Poison stacks. Cooldown: 18s.
cn_description: 为武器涂毒，使接下来4.25秒内所有近战攻击附加2层中毒。冷却时间18秒。

en_description: Cooldown -5s.
cn_description: 冷却时间减少5秒。

en_description: The first melee attack after Poison Coating applies 8 additional Poison stacks.
cn_description: 涂毒后的首次近战攻击额外附加8层中毒。

en_description: Poison stacks applied by melee attacks +1.
cn_description: 近战攻击附加的中毒层数增加1层。

en_description: While Poison-Coated, Knife damage applies 1 Poison stack.
cn_description: 涂毒状态下，飞刀造成伤害时附加1层中毒。

en_description: While Poison-Coated, release a poison mist when hit, applying Cripple and 6 Poison stacks to nearby enemies.
cn_description: 涂毒状态下，受到攻击时，释放一片毒雾，对周围的敌人附加残废，并附加6层中毒。
